mood: Landscape of offset asphalt arcs enclosing a near-black navy void beneath white cumulus. A large railed arc curls into translucent pointed fins; a second lies low with faint warm light. Smaller features are a pleated rail edge, a pastel-tinted pavement swell, a squared speckled road lip and a lobed inner edge. Silver rails and white lanes follow the arcs; a cloud interrupts the low dark divide.
material_language: Smooth matte slate asphalt, faint seams and localized subdued color grain
Closely spaced silver guardrails on repeated dark supports
Thin smoky translucent pavement tips continuous with solid asphalt
Soft white cloud volume with flattened blue-gray undersides
lighting: Cool diffuse sky light; bright cloud crowns above the low divide, blue-gray undersides, and a faint localized straw-and-rose glow on the low arc.
object_inventory: A broad silver-railed asphalt arc curling into smoky pointed fins
A low reclining road arc with dithered straw light and a faint rose rim
A short pleated silver rail edge with muted displaced color shadows
A smooth saddle-shaped pavement swell with faint textured pastel bands
A squared thin road lip with sparse purple-and-yellow surface speckling
A lobed asphalt inner edge enclosing dark blue with softly tinted margins
negative_constraints: No continuous original S-bend, original distant fin pair, pasted source panel or near-identical reconstruction.
No thick broken slabs, exposed support blocks, rubble, flooded ruins or additional landscape scenery.
No labels, legible text, logos, cards, pins, target rings, crosshairs, calibration ticks or debug marks.
No copied characters, human figures, cartoon stars, office props, camel tableau or cultural emblems.
No dominant warm pavement, bright pink fractures or rainbow-wide recoloring; keep color translations localized and subordinate.
No generic mist replacing highway silhouettes; every detached roadway retains visible rails and lanes, with open darkness between arcs.
